intro:
An image, a note, or a file.
One shortcut. Always within reach.
details.heading: Just enough.
details.intro: Pin it, resize it, and keep going.
content.heading: Images
content.body:
Fill the window or fit the whole image.
Copy the original with one click.
placement.heading: Text
placement.body:
Select, edit, and copy right in the pin.
Your edits are saved across restarts.
shortcut.heading: Files
shortcut.body:
Icons or a list. Open or drag to Finder.
Right-click to rename or remove references.
closing.heading: Keep it close.
closing.body: Give your clipboard a place to stay.
title: Pir — Copy it. Keep it in sight.
description: Keep images, editable notes and files in sight with a lightweight macOS app.
usage.caption: Actual Pir windows · images, text & files
usage.text: An editable text pin in Pir
usage.files: Native file icons in a Pir file pin
start.heading: Three steps. Keep it in sight.
start.copy.body: Copy an image, some text, or files and folders in Finder.
start.pin.body: Use the default shortcut in any app to pin your clipboard. Set your own shortcut in Preferences.
start.arrange.body: Drag a pin to move it, resize from its edges, and hover to reveal controls in the upper-left corner.
